capture.method: rendered vertical inactive and horizontal active PaneDivider instances directly in each pinned source archive, captured character frames and spans, then exercised the full five-cell vertical pointer target

horizontalActive.stableDifference: the stable branch predates the baseline theme contrast adjustment; both versions use accent and accentMuted semantic tokens

pointer.backendProjection: Crossterm exposes drag and mouse-up but no separate drag-end event; Workdeck releases the same captured resize state once on mouse-up, equivalent to Hunk's idempotent end handler on drag-end and mouse-up

normalization: Workdeck naming and backend event spelling only; terminal geometry, paint, drag capture, resize delta, and final lifecycle state are not normalized
